10.title: 3 Bedroom Apartment for Sale
10.description: Stunning 3 bedroom penthouse apartment in the heart of Edinburgh's New Town. Open-plan living and dining area with floor-to-ceiling windows offering panoramic views across the city to Arthur's Seat. Designer kitchen with stone worktops and premium appliances. Master bedroom with en-suite and walk-in wardrobe. Two further double bedrooms and family bathroom. Secure underground parking and lift access. Minutes from Princes Street and Edinburgh Waverley station.

11.title: 4 Bedroom House for Sale
11.description: Beautifully presented 4 bedroom detached country house in the heart of Hampshire countryside. Featuring a grand entrance hallway, spacious living room with bay windows, separate dining room, and a modern kitchen with granite worktops and integrated appliances. Upstairs offers 4 double bedrooms including a master with en-suite and dressing area. Family bathroom with roll-top bath. Landscaped gardens with mature trees, double garage, and gated driveway.

12.title: 2 Bedroom Apartment for Sale
12.description: Exquisite 2 bedroom luxury flat in the heart of Chelsea, London. Beautifully appointed throughout with premium finishes. Spacious open-plan reception room with hardwood flooring and contemporary fireplace. Bespoke kitchen with marble worktops and Miele appliances. Master bedroom with fitted wardrobes and en-suite bathroom. Second double bedroom with built-in storage. Communal gardens and porter service. Steps from Kings Road boutiques and Sloane Square tube.

13.title: 4 Bedroom House for Sale
13.description: Impressive 4 bedroom detached family house in the sought-after Summertown area of Oxford. Ground floor features a spacious entrance hall, dual-aspect living room, separate dining room, study, and large kitchen/breakfast room opening onto the garden. First floor offers 4 generous bedrooms including master with en-suite shower room, plus a family bathroom. Private south-facing rear garden with patio and lawn. Detached garage with driveway parking. Close to excellent schools, shops, and University Parks.

14.title: Studio Apartment for Sale
14.description: Well-presented studio apartment in the heart of Leeds city centre. Open-plan living space with modern kitchen area, sleeping area, and stylish shower room. The building offers secure entry, lift access, and on-site management. Walking distance to Leeds train station, shops, restaurants, and the university. Ideal for first-time buyers or buy-to-let investors. Currently achieving £650pcm rental income.

15.title: 2 Bedroom Apartment for Sale
15.description: Spacious 2 bedroom maisonette in Edgbaston, Birmingham. Spread over two floors with a private entrance. Ground floor has a large living room and modern fitted kitchen with appliances. Upstairs features 2 double bedrooms and a bathroom with shower over bath. Benefits from double glazing, gas central heating, and allocated parking. Close to Five Ways station and Edgbaston Village with its boutique shops and restaurants.

16.title: 3 Bedroom House for Sale
16.description: Beautiful 3 bedroom Cotswold stone cottage in the picturesque village of Bourton-on-the-Water, Gloucestershire. Grade II listed with character features including exposed stone walls, wooden beams, and inglenook fireplace. Country-style kitchen with Aga, separate dining room, and cosy sitting room. Three bedrooms upstairs with family bathroom. Mature cottage garden with views over rolling countryside. Garden shed and off-road parking for 2 cars.

17.title: 3 Bedroom Apartment for Sale
17.description: Spectacular 3 bedroom penthouse apartment on the Liverpool waterfront. Occupying the entire top floor with panoramic views of the Mersey and city skyline. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the open-plan living space with natural light. Designer kitchen with Siemens appliances, quartz worktops, and breakfast bar. Master bedroom with en-suite and private balcony. Two further double bedrooms and family bathroom. Secure underground parking for 2 cars. Concierge and gym access included.
